propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge to make the merged commit reachable from HEAD before closing a ticket.

The close completion precheck reads git history from HEAD to verify the rebar-ticket: commit is reachable; uncommitted WIP on the shared checkout gets clobbered if that checkout is fast-forwarded instead of the author's worktree.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md lack explicit guidance that operators should advance only their personal worktree and never touch the shared main checkout during post-merge close workflow.
The fix is documentation-only: add post-merge fast-forward instructions to AGENTS.md close-discipline section and create new CONTRIBUTING.md §2f subsection with the same guidance.
